sources.scope: Default-branch snapshots of active simulation and zylem repositories. Archived behaviors repository checked for continuity; active catalog used as authoritative. Excludes unmerged branches, example-only custom behaviors, internal state enums, and configuration types. Includes every catalog ID, all mapped genre nodes, five exported coordinators, four camera behaviors and the runtime-2d mechanics entry.
